description: Bornes de recharges de véhicules éléctriques - CA Territoires Vendômois is a dataset listed in data.vendome.catv open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by data.vendome.catv. Liste des bornes de recharges de véhicules électriques disponibles sur le territoire de la CA Territoires Vendômois. Coverage: Territoires Vendômois (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Mobilité. The portal shows 32 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-08-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-vendome-catv41-centrevaldeloire-portal.
